This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Why do Japanese and South Korean soldiers attach strange bags to their rifles? Discover how brass catchers help militaries collect spent shell casings, prevent ammunition theft, and avoid hours of tedious cleanup. From modern military training to World War I aircraft, these simple devices have a surprisingly interesting history.
